Integrations

Use the API to report data or build on Gratheon

The web app is only one client. The same contracts let hive hardware write measurements in, and let other software read colony state out. If you already collect weight, climate, entrance events, or inspection records, you should talk to Gratheon through the API instead of inventing a parallel store.

Connect if you build devices, operate a beekeeping platform, or need structured hive data for research and automation. REST stays stable for field firmware. GraphQL is the faster path for software integrations that can absorb schema changes.

  • Device and firmware teams reporting telemetry from scales, climate sensors, or cameras
  • Beekeeping software vendors embedding hive maps, inspections, or alerts
  • Researchers and data platforms that want events in the same shape the web app uses
